facts.business: Aanchal Ispat Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of steel products, including TMT bars and structural steel, and also undertakes job work for related parties.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on going concern uncertainty due to CIRP, unpaid installments of Rs. 21.50 crore under Resolution Plan, Rs. 3.00 crore held in fixed deposits pending allocation, and significant related party transactions with Maina International Ltd. (34.93% of sales, 33.45% of purchases).

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to pending implementation of Resolution Plan
Unpaid installments of Rs. 21.50 crore under approved Resolution Plan
High dependence on related party Maina International Ltd. for 34.93% of sales and 33.45% of purchases
Equity shares under BSE surveillance framework 'IBC / IRP Stage-I'
Pending NCLT application for revision of payment timelines by Successful Resolution Applicant
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with Maina International Ltd., a related party under common control, accounted for 34.93% of total sales and 33.45% of total purchases during FY 2025-26. The Company has a job work agreement with Maina International Ltd. from which entire job work income is derived. Management represents these transactions were at arm's length.
